doc: docs/02 §9 sampling settings by stage. temperature/top_p/repeat_penalty go to the request's sampling; `dose` is the steering dose base for that stage (P2.02/P2.04 own dose and number tuning). Shape: {"stages": {"<0-5>": row}}. A legacy stage-agnostic file (one flat row at the top level, no `stages`) still applies that row to every stage. `hardened` records the docs/06 §1 envelope the schema limits are tested against.

hardened.doc: docs/06 §1: maxLength on strings + repeat_penalty 1.15 + temperature 0.7 kept 100% valid JSON up to steering scale 12. A stage whose dose enters the 8-12 band must keep repeat_penalty at or above the floor; the schema must carry the string limits (docs/02 §3: inner 90, say 200).
